name: Bramble
tagline: A password manager that syncs your logins directly between your devices
description:
Bramble is a local-first password manager that keeps your passwords and passkeys encrypted and stored on your own devices, syncing them directly between phone, browser, and desktop over a private peer-to-peer mesh instead of a central server.

It supports passkeys, YubiKeys, and 2FA codes alongside regular passwords, and is available on Android, iOS, and as browser extensions.
